evidence_snippets: BigLake tables support the following formats: Avro CSV Delta Lake Iceberg JSON ORC Parquet You can't use cached metadata with Apache Iceberg external tables ; BigQuery already uses the metadata that Iceberg captures in manifest files.

You can reference BigLake tables anywhere in a SELECT statement as if they were standard BigQuery tables, including in data manipulation language (DML) and data definition language (DDL) statements that use subqueries to retrieve data.
